definition.metric_family: connected-component area, normalized by native image area
definition.coordinate_system: native image pixels, normalized by native image area
definition.resize_convention: NONE for the taxonomy (native masks); the training pipeline separately applies aspect-ratio-preserving resize + centre pad to 512
definition.acquisition_scope: FULL_FIELD only (ROI components were not primary-binned)
definition.boundary_semantics: lower-inclusive / upper-exclusive cumulative: a value exactly equal to a quartile falls into the LOWER bin
definition.case_level_convention: per-case flags contains_{tiny,small,medium,large}_object plus dominant_object_stratum from the largest component

sources.establishes: canonical taxonomy module: STRATA, TAXONOMY_VERSION, compute_size_thresholds, stratum_for_ratio, assign_component_strata, assign_sample_strata
component extraction: analyze_kub_mask_v2(mask_path, connectivity=8); component_ratio = c_pixels / total_pixels
documented preprocessing: SegmentationTransform — aspect-ratio-preserving resize (scale = min(size/w, size/h)) + centre pad; mask binarized as (> 0)
frozen threshold record (taxonomy_version kub_size_v1, connectivity 8, Q25/Q50/Q75)
provenance: source split/scope/counts, source table hashes, test_mask_reads 0
historical TRAIN stratum counts by anatomical category
legacy driver: reuses compute_size_thresholds from the canonical module

disagreement_note: No competing definition was found. All located sources (module, threshold record, provenance record, threshold table, legacy driver, notebook) implement the same kub_size_v1 quartile taxonomy over FULL_FIELD TRAIN components.

critical_question_answers.A_native_pixels: PARTIAL — native pixels, but NORMALIZED by native image area
critical_question_answers.B_512_representation: NO — the taxonomy used native masks; 512 resize+pad is a separate training-pipeline transform
critical_question_answers.F_bbox_area: NO (bbox geometry is recorded but not the taxonomy metric)
critical_question_answers.G_component_area: YES — connected-component area, normalized as a fraction of native image area (component_ratio)
critical_question_answers.conclusion: The historical metric is G: connected-component area normalized by native image area (component_ratio). The "<32 px" hypothesis is NOT supported by any canonical source.

resize_convention.training_pipeline: aspect-ratio-preserving resize + centre pad to 512x512 (scale = min(512/w, 512/h); rw=round(w*scale), rh=round(h*scale); bilinear image, nearest mask)
